title: When the Horizon Sings Again
author: Petra Ishikawa
blurb: Freya Lockridge, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
